// Exact pinned upstream old-SDK runtime-contract helper prefix is prepended.
#[test]
fn export_actual_post_append_missing_and_malformed_ack_reconciliation() {
    let api=PluginApi {
        abi_version:rpi_plugin_sdk::RPI_PLUGIN_ABI_VERSION_UNIFIED,
        struct_size:std::mem::size_of::<PluginApi>() as u32,free_string,
        register_tool:Some(register_tool),register_command:Some(register_command),
        register_shortcut:None,register_flag:None,register_provider:None,
        register_message_renderer:None,register_markdown_transformer:None,
        register_entry_renderer:None,register_event_handler:Some(register_event),
        register_resources_discover:None,runtime_action:runtime,dispatch_event:None,
        user_data:std::ptr::null_mut(),declare:None,register_before_agent_start:None,
        register_oauth_provider:None,
    };
    assert_eq!(rpi_durable::rpi_plugin_register(&api),0);
    assert_eq!(empty(EventTag::SessionStart),0);
    let cases:Value=serde_json::from_str(include_str!("cases.json")).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(cases["schema"],"rpi-synthetic-ack-uncertain-cases-v1");
    assert_eq!(cases["frames"].as_array().unwrap().len(),10);
    let mut frames=Vec::new();
    for frame in cases["frames"].as_array().unwrap() {
        let index=frame["index"].as_u64().unwrap();
        let kind=frame["kind"].as_str().unwrap();
        let before=host().lock().unwrap().entries.clone();
        if kind=="missingAck" {host().lock().unwrap().missing_ack=true;}
        if kind=="malformedAck" {host().lock().unwrap().invalid_json_ack=true;}
        let (channel,result,error)=if kind=="reload" {
            assert!(frame["action"].is_null());
            assert_eq!(empty(EventTag::SessionTree),0);
            ("event-ok",None,None)
        }else{
            match action(frame["action"].clone()) {
                Ok(value)=>{
                    let error=value["details"]["error"].as_str().map(str::to_owned);
                    (if error.is_some(){"details-error"}else{"done"},Some(value),error)
                },
                Err(error)=>("tool-error",None,Some(error)),
            }
        };
        let entries=host().lock().unwrap().entries.clone();
        assert_eq!(entries.len() as u64,frame["oldEntries"].as_u64().unwrap());
        let replayed=serde_json::to_value(rpi_durable_core::DurableState::try_from_branch(&entries).unwrap()).unwrap();
        let expected:rpi_durable_core::DurableState=serde_json::from_value(frame["expected"].clone()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(replayed,serde_json::to_value(expected).unwrap(),"persisted case {index}");
        match kind {
            "commit"=>{assert_eq!(channel,"done");assert_eq!(entries.len(),before.len()+1);},
            "missingAck"|"malformedAck"=>{
                assert_eq!(channel,"tool-error");
                assert!(error.as_ref().unwrap().starts_with("durable append acknowledgement is unknown:"));
                assert_eq!(entries.len(),before.len()+1,"host DID commit, never report rollback");
                assert!(!host().lock().unwrap().missing_ack);
                assert!(!host().lock().unwrap().invalid_json_ack);
            },
            "retry"=>{
                assert_eq!(channel,"details-error");
                assert!(error.as_ref().unwrap().contains("durable append acknowledgement is unknown:"));
                assert_eq!(entries,before,"no blind retry against stale anchor");
                let retry=frame["retryOf"].as_u64().unwrap() as usize;
                assert_eq!(frame["action"],cases["frames"][retry]["action"]);
            },
            "reload"=>{assert_eq!(channel,"event-ok");assert_eq!(entries,before);},
            "read"=>{assert_eq!(channel,"done");assert_eq!(entries,before);},
            _=>panic!("unknown fixed case"),
        }
        let status=action(json!({"action":"status"})).unwrap();
        let blocked=frame["oldBlocked"].as_bool().unwrap();
        let visible=if blocked {
            assert!(status["details"]["error"].as_str().unwrap().contains("durable append acknowledgement is unknown:"));
            let details=status["details"].as_object().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(details.len(),2,"blocked status must not leak stale control fields");
            assert_eq!(details["action"],"status");
            assert!(details.contains_key("error"));
            None
        }else{
            let mut state=status["details"].clone();
            state.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("action").unwrap();
            assert_eq!(state,replayed,"readable case {index}");
            Some(state)
        };
        assert_eq!(host().lock().unwrap().entries,entries,"status never reconciles by writing");
        let reads=host().lock().unwrap().read_requests.len();
        assert_eq!(reads as u64,frame["oldReads"].as_u64().unwrap(),"only explicit reload reads branch");
        frames.push(json!({"index":index,"label":frame["label"],"kind":kind,"action":frame["action"],
            "oldChannel":channel,"oldResult":result,"oldError":error,"oldBlocked":blocked,
            "oldVisible":visible,"persisted":replayed,"entryCount":entries.len(),
            "entryId":entries.last().map(|entry|entry["id"].clone()),"oldReads":reads}));
    }
    let entries=host().lock().unwrap().entries.clone();
    assert_eq!(entries.len(),4);
    assert_eq!(entries[0]["data"]["kind"],"snapshot");
    assert_eq!(entries[0]["data"]["revision"],1);
    let artifact=json!({"schema":"rpi-synthetic-legacy-ack-uncertain-export-v1",
        "legacyCommit":"041c981b21ac42348feee371757f5ef26ecbdcab",
        "pluginSha256":"0f4be632b1f5dab5dfa0ac9cf55bb9119b1a37ec3ac195f08161dca9480fdaac",
        "casesSha256":"2db451f05628e51f75b08795c91cc9d715f866064623846f1da9a2f25ef2c791",
        "frames":frames,"entries":entries});
    // Runner-owned synthetic TempDir only, no real journal/config/data import.
    let path=std::env::var_os("RPI_SYNTHETIC_LEGACY_ACK_UNCERTAIN_EXPORT").expect("explicit synthetic export path");
    use std::io::Write;
    let mut file=std::fs::OpenOptions::new().create_new(true).write(true).open(path).unwrap();
    file.write_all(serde_json::to_string(&artifact).unwrap().as_bytes()).unwrap();
}
